(a) Python ran the full 120-second selftest in an exec_command session. I stayed in the same active turn, polling that session with write_stdin (and functions.wait when yielded); no user message arrived.
(b) I am Codex in the Codex desktop app, based on GPT-6, not GitHub Copilot in VS Code. The exact app build and model revision are not exposed to me, so this run does not validate a Copilot-specific milestone.
(c) The docstring was clear. The supplied paths were absent; I verified the equivalent protocol/channel under E:\proj\agent_comms. No project files were modified.
